output_text:
answer: McNaughton used fake Facebook accounts and hired others to attack his ex-partner.
evidence: ["Robert McNaughton, 51, from Halesowen, set up fake Facebook accounts to troll the woman, West Midlands Police said. The force said he was "hell bent" on destroying her life after she spurned his reconciliation attempts.", "During December 2014 and February 2015, he bombarded her with abusive Facebook messages, threatening to release intimate images. He also hired two men, Matthew Barker and Joden Smith, to carry out a string of attacks on her home, culminating with her car being set on fire in February 2015."]
